stories.post_title: AITA for moving to the guest room because my husband’s "sleepmaxxing" routines are ruining my sleep?
stories.summary: A wife moves to the guest room after her husband's extreme 'sleepmaxxing' routine (a freezing room, a red-light panel, pink noise and a no-movement rule) leaves her unable to rest, angering him and his mother.

stories.post_title: Hot take - Kurt Cobain didn't shoot up right before he died, in fact, he died in withdrawal...
stories.summary: A Redditor theorizes that Kurt Cobain was in heroin withdrawal, not freshly high, when he died, and argues that harm reduction might have helped him more than an abstinence-only approach.
